- Run targeted `rg` checks after edits to confirm every documented env var/label/contract statement matches code presence or is clearly marked reserved.
- Verify anchor discipline: only append under specified stable anchors; no reflow/reordering of unrelated sections.
- Sanity-check that docs consistently distinguish `ai:validation-failed` (runtime semantic failure) vs `ai:validate-failed` (validate-workflow Codex/terminal failure).
